title: INC-1044 Kafka Orders Consumer postmortem
content: INC-1044 postmortem for Kafka Orders Consumer, published 2026-04-18T16:00:00Z. Impact window 2026-04-18T13:40:00Z to 2026-04-18T15:18:00Z. Customer impact: order events accumulated and downstream fulfillment updates were delayed by 47 minutes. During triage one team proposed a Kafka broker leader election throttling reads; another proposed a malformed event causing repeated deserialization failures. These conflicting preliminary hypotheses were rejected after checking INC-1044-LOGS and service metrics. Confirmed root cause: a consumer release set max.poll.records to 10 instead of 500, reducing throughput below the inbound event rate. Decisive evidence: consumer group lag reached 890000 records while broker health remained normal; configuration diff showed max.poll.records=10. Recovery and prevention: restored max.poll.records to 500, scaled consumers temporarily, and added lag-based deployment checks. Follow-up owner is the Kafka Orders Consumer on-call team. Evidence source IDs: INC-1044-REPORT, INC-1044-LOGS, INC-1044-RUNBOOK. This postmortem source ID is INC-1044-POSTMORTEM.
